game.core.world.faction.summary: A small, militant philosophical order that trains perception and prediction, believing total awareness of the world's invisible tension will let a sufficiently disciplined mind finally 'see' the divine source behind Caldris's Nine Lamps.
goals: Achieve perfect, unified perception of the world's invisible tension
Understand the true nature of Caldris's Nine Lamps through disciplined observation
methods: Study of stillness, breath, and reflex under the Prediction Court's bells
assets: The House of the Ninth Angle monastery in Highmead
The Prediction Court, a garden of suspended bells used to test perception

agenda.summary: Three monks have been sent down the Lantern Road to bring Ganji home before his absence becomes a crisis of faith within the sect.
